calls.video_title: 4 Stocks You’ll Wish You Bought on This Dip (One Is Down Over 50%)
calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Alec Green) — Tyler Technologies sells efficiency software to governments; contracts are extremely sticky, earnings are stable and trending up, and the SaaS sell-off on AI-replacement fears was overblown — AI augments rather than replaces its work. No price stated.
